title.narrative: Our Children Our Future: Assessing Needs of Children in Domestic Labour

description.narrative: Our project addresses the problem of domestic child labour in Borama District, Somalia. Years of civil unrest, displacement, loss of parents due to HIV/AIDS and war, poverty and the search for survival have compelled and continue to drive children as young as 5 years old into life of domestic servitude, exploitation and abuse. We are proposing to conduct a research on children involved domestic labour to obtain evidence of need, identify local assets and to cultivate opportunities for collaborative work with duty bearers in tackling the problem of domestic child labour. The research will inform strategies for the prevention of domestic child labour, exploitation and abuse; our planned community and family extension work to raise awareness about children at risk and to change the attitudes and practices to the use of domestic child labour; and our advocacy for vulnerable children. As a result we anticipate to that our work will help build capacity of duty bearers and other street-serving-organisations to meet the needs of children and protect them from harm; strengthen commitment by duty bearers to improve and uphold policies and practices that protect children at all levels; improve the capacity of children to be consulted, heard and be involved.
